claim_boundary: This is a retrospective, post-freeze external benchmark on frozen image bytes. It is development evidence and is not added to the original frozen claim or presented as a state-of-the-art comparison.

task.input: one 1000x1000 finer-sampling reference and one 1000x1000 wider-field search image
task.output: reference field-of-view center (x, y) in search-image pixels
task.error: Euclidean center error in search-image pixels
task.success_denominator: all selected records; unresolved estimates count as failures

upstream.project: XFeat: Accelerated Features for Lightweight Image Matching
upstream.license_note: The checkpoint is distributed inside the Apache-2.0 repository; no separate checkpoint license was found in the pinned tree.

fixed_adapter.reference_resampling: resize to round(native_dimension * 0.1) with cv2.INTER_AREA, then repeat grayscale into three identical uint8 channels
fixed_adapter.search_preprocessing: repeat grayscale into three identical uint8 channels; no intensity normalization beyond the official implementation's division by 255
fixed_adapter.coordinate: project the pixel-center coordinate ((w-1)/2, (h-1)/2) of the nominally downsampled reference through the estimated homography
unresolved_conditions: fewer than four official XFeat* matches
fixed_adapter.out_of_bounds_policy: finite projections are retained and scored even when outside the search frame
fixed_adapter.origin_of_settings: XFeat* top_k=8000 and USAC_MAGSAC(3.5 px, 1000 iterations, 0.999 confidence) are copied from the pinned official matching-and-registration notebook; only the known 0.1 sampling-ratio adaptation is task-specific

determinism.warmup: none; the first selected record is included in runtime summaries
determinism.runtime_scope: reference resampling, official matching, MAGSAC, and center projection; excludes image decoding, manifest hashing, and one-time model loading

primary_population.label: retrospective-frozen-report-all1400
primary_population.selection: all records in all seven frozen reporting manifests

runtime_gate.purpose: choose full-population versus predeclared subset using runtime only, never accuracy, coverage, matches, or errors
runtime_gate.timing_probe: within each (suite, architecture), the record with the smallest SHA-256 of manifest_sha256 + NUL + record_id; 14 records total
runtime_gate.full_population_condition: projected adapter runtime for 1400 records is at most 4500 seconds
runtime_gate.inspection_rule: do not print or inspect prediction, status, match, inlier, or error fields until the population decision is recorded

predeclared_runtime_fallback.label: retrospective-frozen-report-hash-stratified-280
predeclared_runtime_fallback.selection: within each (suite, architecture), take the 20 records with the smallest SHA-256 of manifest_sha256 + NUL + record_id
predeclared_runtime_fallback.rationale: equal 20-record cells preserve suite and architecture coverage without outcome-dependent selection

independent_renderer_population.label: independent-renderer-final100-development
independent_renderer_population.selection: all records in the bound final-100 manifest, evaluated only after the frozen-population decision
independent_renderer_population.claim_boundary: development transfer check; renderer source overlaps repository development and is not a held-out claim

forbidden_after_lock: change XFeat mode or top_k after inspecting outcomes
change homography thresholds after inspecting outcomes
select or omit records based on predictions or errors
describe the result as a state-of-the-art benchmark
